name: FA_MASS_TRX_DETAILS
description: FA_MASS_TRX_DETAILS contains the new transaction details for mass transaction requests.  Oracle Fusion Assets uses this information when determining the new transaction details for each of the candidate assets selected based on the criteria in the FA_MASS_TRANSACTIONS table.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mass transaction.

columns.name: METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation method to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: FLAT_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the flat rate record to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_CAPACITY
columns.description: Total production capacity to be assigned to candidate assets depreciating under a units of production depreciation method.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of measure to be assigned to candidate assets depreciating under a units of production depreciation method.

columns.name: CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation prorate convention to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: CEILING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation ceiling to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: CASH_GENERATING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the cash generating unit to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSOCIATION
columns.description: Group asset association option for selected candidate assets. Association is limited to standalone or member asset type.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the group asset to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Date to be assigned as the new date placed in service to candidate assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Salvage type to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_PERCENT
columns.description: Salvage value percentage to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value amount to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Depreciation limit type to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_PERCENT
columns.description: Depreciation limit percentage to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation limit amount to be assigned to candidate assets.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the distribution set to be applied to candidate assets.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO
columns.description: Identifier of the person to be applied as the custodian of candidate assets.

columns.name: PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Total proceeds from the sale of all assets in the batch to be allocated to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Total cost of removing all the assets in the batch to be allocated to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Retirement type to be assigned to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the prorate convention to be assigned to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: SOLD_TO
columns.description: Name of the party to whom all the assets were sold, which will be assigned to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM
columns.description: Internal reference number to be assigned to the candidate assets during retirement.

columns.name: UNITS_TO_RETIRE
columns.description: Total number of units to retire. Used in performing unit-based retirements of the candidate assets up to this limit.
